correctness.rationale: The source Delta_(4,7) is 2-connected by the explicitly quoted chessboard connectivity bound min(4,7,floor(12/3))-2=2. All seven reflections of D7 fix four rook vertices and together generate D7, giving pi1 of the geometric quotient zero by Armstrong. The independent finite orbit-of-flags chain enumeration generates all 28+252+840+840 nonempty faces and every flag with precise canonical orbit orientations. It verifies d²=0 and 142,1236,2520,1440 orbit-cell counts. Exact integer unit reductions leave 1,0,3,18 chain generators; all 1x1, 2x2 and 3x3 minors of the remaining 3x18 matrix have gcds 2,4,8, hence Smith 2,2,2 with 15-dimensional kernel. A simply connected 3-dimensional CW complex with this attaching matrix is homotopy equivalent to three M(Z/2,2) and fifteen 3-spheres. Burnside Euler check (-224+7*4)/14=-14 agrees. The standard-library checker was executed successfully from the stated package path; no finite-field heuristic or logs alone certify the claim.

value.rationale: The seven-column case is the first 4-row full chessboard at the two-connectivity and shellability threshold (7=2*4-1). Its natural full dihedral column quotient unexpectedly introduces three independent 2-torsion second-homotopy classes, while the 2-connected covering complex has the integral homotopy type of 225 three-spheres. A complete wedge-of-Moore-spaces homotopy classification at this motivated threshold is stronger and more useful than a rational quotient Betti count or a coincidental invariant of arbitrary parameters.
